prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1477; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported head impact and subsequent headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. Over the course of 17 visits, the patient received care consistent with standard management of concussion, including symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive assessment, graduated activity guidance, and gradual return-to-activity planning. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms and the force involved in the collision. Examination revealed some findings supportive of a concussive injury, including mild balance deficits and reduced performance on portions of cognitive screening, while other neurological tests, including cranial nerve function, strength, and coordination, remained within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck region is documented in the available history. Treatment frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved, and the patient was discharged from active care once symptoms had largely resolved. Billed services reflect the treatment provided, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified.
